newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Nacional de Chocolates net up.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Nacional de Chocolates net up.

text.p: Colombian chocolate manufacturer Compania Nacional De Chocolates said its 1996 net profits rose 20.7 percent to 62.85 billion pesos compared to 1995.

The company, the flagship of the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate's food sector, has proposed distributing 28.06 billion peso profits in dividends of 28.75 pesos per share per month between April 1997 and March 1998 -- up from last year's dividend of 23 persos per share per month.
Nacional de Chocolate has 81.35 million paid up shares and its main shareholders are other companies within the Sindicato Antioqueo, including its financial arm Corfinsura
